scope: Perform one final non-cohort diagnosis of the failed OPT-009 positive semantic canary. First prove offline how displayed line-number prefixes interact with exact citation canonicalization; then, only if all offline integrity checks pass, make one no-retry exact frozen-prompt repeat and one no-retry diagnostic-clarification call over the same pre-frozen OWASP Benchmark positive. Persist only aggregate citation-validation and deterministic transformation-category counts, usage, cost, and a close-or-correct recommendation; stop without changing the production instrument or OPT-009 status.

required_checks: verify every retained, instrument, benchmark, diagnostic, pricing, and production-store digest
prove an exact unnumbered benchmark citation canonicalizes under the frozen boundary
prove the same citation with the displayed NUMBER<TAB> prefix fails exact canonicalization
prove deterministic removal of only the displayed NUMBER<TAB> prefix recovers the exact citation without changing source code characters
prove both prospective diagnostic requests fit the frozen region and complete-content byte ceilings
prove the production store remains byte-identical
offline_diagnosis.pass_gate: Every check must pass before provider use. Otherwise persist one offline-only inconclusive result recommending closure and stop with zero provider attempts.

provider_diagnosis.source: Only the numbered public source of BenchmarkTest00099 may be transmitted.
provider_diagnosis.call_one: Use the exact frozen OWASP prompt and schema once, with no retry. Classify each schema-valid citation in memory as exact, display-prefix-recoverable, other-nonverbatim, ambiguous, or absent, then discard raw output.
provider_diagnosis.call_two: Only if call one records authoritative usage, append the frozen diagnostic-only clarification to the exact system prompt and call the same source and schema once, with no retry. Apply the same aggregate in-memory classification and discard raw output.
provider_diagnosis.diagnosis_success_gate: A bounded line-prefix diagnosis is supported only if the exact frozen repeat has no exact citation, at least one citation becomes exact after removal of only displayed NUMBER<TAB> prefixes, and the clarified call returns at least one exact citation matching the pre-frozen upstream sink anchor. Any other pattern is inconclusive.
provider_diagnosis.success_effect: Recommend, but do not implement, a separately versioned prompt/rendering correction followed by fresh non-cohort qualification. Planner v2 and source activation remain deferred.
provider_diagnosis.inconclusive_effect: Recommend closing OPT-009 at its current scope. Closure and branch integration remain separately authorized actions.

stop_conditions: Any bound digest differs, the offline diagnosis fails, or the production store changes.
Any host other than api.anthropic.com is contacted or any source other than BenchmarkTest00099 is transmitted.
Any retry, third provider attempt, ground-truth transfer, raw-output persistence, source excerpt persistence, or finding persistence is attempted.
An attempt lacks authoritative usage, reported tokens exceed 30,000, known dated-price cost exceeds $0.50, elapsed time exceeds 20 minutes, or new data exceeds 10 MiB.
Any production prompt, rendering, citation, planner, threshold, source selection, policy, optimization status, branch, or remote state is changed.
result_boundary: One aggregate diagnosis result may identify only deterministic citation-format categories, call-level schema/exact/anchor counts, authoritative usage, cost, resource compliance, store immutability, and either bounded-correction-supported or inconclusive-close-recommended. It may not disclose raw citations, source excerpts, candidate identities, severity, confidence, rationales, or prospective outcomes; implement a correction; clear the data gate; close OPT-009; merge; or push.

authorization.required_statement: I authorize the OPT-009 final citation diagnosis described by opt-009-citation-diagnosis-receipt-2026-08-13.json, limited first to one offline exact-citation versus displayed-line-prefix canonicalization audit over the frozen BenchmarkTest00099 positive and production-store immutability check, and only if every offline gate passes, one no-retry repeat using the exact frozen OWASP prompt followed, only with authoritative first-call usage, by one no-retry call over the same public source with the frozen diagnostic-only line-prefix clarification; in-memory aggregate classification of citations as exact, display-prefix-recoverable, other-nonverbatim, ambiguous, or absent; scratch-only usage and sanitized validation chronology; and one aggregate diagnosis result recommending either a separately authorized bounded correction or OPT-009 closure, with ceilings of 20 minutes, 10 MiB new data, only api.anthropic.com network access, at most two provider attempts, 30,000 provider-reported tokens, $0.50 known dated-price cost, two scratch model-usage inserts, two scratch validation-failure inserts, and exactly zero production-store mutations, repository materializations, scanner processes, human reviews, assessments, labels, or model training. Ground-truth transfer, raw provider-output or source-excerpt persistence, finding or candidate persistence or disclosure, retries, production prompt or rendering changes, planner v2, remaining-primary or reserve activation, rescoring, tuning, recalibration, threshold selection, packet selection, production-policy changes, OPT-009 status change or closure, branch integration, and remote push remain excluded.
